Hi Alicia / Zenith security team,

Thanks again for taking the time today — great conversation. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can get you the artifacts you requested:

Summary from call:
- Zenith Health: you need the most recent SOC 2 Type II report, a signed bridge letter if available, and temporary access to our trust portal for evidence review. You also mentioned a vendor security questionnaire that your procurement team will send.

Next steps / who does what:
1) Redwood: I will upload our SOC 2 Type II report and a bridge letter to the trust portal and send an invite link to the Zenith security contact (Alicia). (ETA: EOD tomorrow)
2) Zenith: please share the vendor security questionnaire link or attach the doc in reply so we can start answering technical items.
3) If you prefer SSO-based portal access, let me know — we can provision SAML for enterprise customers but we typically send a time-limited invite first.

Attachments: I will attach the SOC 2 PDF and a bridge letter in follow-up.

Estimated timeline: once you confirm we have the right people on the questionnaire, we can typically complete the standard vendor security questionnaire within 3–5 business days for baseline questions; deeper remediation items may take longer.

Would you like Neha (cc'd) to be the technical owner for questionnaire responses? She can coordinate answers and any evidence pulls from infra.

Thanks — I’ll follow up with the portal link and uploads.

Best,
Marissa Cole

Thanks, Marissa — appreciated the recap. A few quick clarifying questions before you upload: 

- Does the SOC 2 Type II report cover the period ending Jul 31, 2026? We need to confirm the coverage window for our audit intake.
- Will the bridge letter explicitly reference the SOC 2 auditor and date of the Type II report? Our procurement team asks for that language.
- For the trust portal invite: can you confirm whether the link will be time-limited and whether we need to register an account (we generally prefer SSO when possible).

I’ve attached our standard vendor security questionnaire (vendor_questionnaire_zenith_2027.docx) — could you have your technical lead review and tell me who on your side will own the responses?

Appreciate it,

Hi Alicia — thanks for the questions and for sending the questionnaire. Answers inline below and next actions: 

- SOC 2 coverage: Our most recent SOC 2 Type II report is dated 2026-07-31 and covers the control period Jan 1, 2026 — Jun 30, 2026.
- Bridge letter: yes — the bridge letter we provide includes auditor name, report date, and confirms no material changes since the report date through the bridge letter issue date. I have attached the bridge letter to this thread and uploaded both docs to the trust portal.
- Trust portal access: the invite link is time-limited (30 days) and does require registering an account. We can provision SSO (SAML) for longer-term customers, but the standard flow is a one-time invite for reviewers.

Portal / artifacts: 
- Uploaded: Redwood_SOC2_TypeII_2026-07-31.pdf (SOC 2 Type II)
- Uploaded: Bridge_Letter_Redwood_20270412.pdf (signed bridge letter)
- Portal invite: https://redwood.trustportal.com/invite/abc123 (expires 2027-05-12)

Neha (cc'd) will be the technical owner for the questionnaire — she will coordinate answers to the technical and infra controls. Neha, Alicia: can you confirm who on Zenith should be the portal reviewer (email for invite)?

If you'd like, we can also set up a short (30m) follow-up call with Neha to walk the questionnaire together.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
